name: Dynastic Royal Marriage Alliance
description: Unite two reigning royal houses in holy matrimony, fusing armies, banners, and succession claims.
creativePrompt: Who are the prince and princess pledged in union? What dowry lands were pledged as marriage gift?
exampleNarrative: Before three archbishops and ten thousand witnesses, the golden rings were exchanged, merging two ancient kingdoms.

name: Mutual Defense Holy League
description: Ratify a multilateral defense treaty: an attack upon any member sovereign is deemed an attack on all.
creativePrompt: What common existential threat spurred formerly hostile realms to swear mutual protection?
exampleNarrative: Five monarchs pressed their royal signets into red sealing wax, binding their realms into an indissoluble defensive league.

name: Grand Continental Silk Road Treaty
description: Abolish internal tariffs and open border gates to create a unified duty-free trans-continental trade network.
creativePrompt: What standard currency exchange rate was fixed by the treaty? What merchant courts resolve disputes?
exampleNarrative: Caravans bearing silk, glass, and cinnamon passed through border gates without delay under the universal merchant accord.

name: Historic Peace Accord & Demilitarization
description: Conclude decades of devastating border warfare with a formal peace congress and exchange of hostages.
creativePrompt: What disputed border river or mountain valley was declared permanent neutral territory?
exampleNarrative: The generals broke their ceremonial swords over the conference table, proclaiming an era of peace for their children.

name: Surveyed Boundary Line Treaty
description: Commission neutral cartographers to survey the frontier and plant granite boundary markers along the divide.
creativePrompt: How were local shepherd pasture rights preserved along the newly surveyed frontier line?
exampleNarrative: Stone boundary obelisks carved with the emblems of both crowns were planted along the mountain divide, ending century-old feuds.

name: Transnational Scholarly Fellowship
description: Fund an open exchange program allowing philosophers, architects, and healers safe passage between all nations.
creativePrompt: What universal passport seal grants scholars immunity from search and arrest during times of war?
exampleNarrative: Bearing the wax seal of the Academy, natural philosophers traveled freely through war zones to study astronomical phenomena.

name: Permanent Imperial Embassy Delegation
description: Establish permanent diplomatic legations in foreign capitals to manage intelligence and treaties in real-time.
creativePrompt: Which master diplomat acts as the eyes and ears of the sovereign in the rival court?
exampleNarrative: The imperial embassy stood across from the royal palace, its dispatch riders galloping daily with encrypted diplomatic pouches.

name: Planar Concordat & Dragon Oath
description: Negotiate an immortal blood-pact with ancient primordial dragons or elemental spirits to guard the realm.
creativePrompt: What tribute or sacred vow must the mortal sovereigns renew every century to preserve the dragon pact?
exampleNarrative: The great gold wyrm dipped its horned head in solemn covenant, swearing that no demonic host would cross the mountain skies.
